title: The Token Margin
description: When does calling an LLM pay off? Pick a task complexity, model tier, and expected profit per decision: the lognormal token distribution — anchored to the paper's 30× variance finding — shows the fraction of invocations that beat break-even. Drag profit up until the green zone dominates.
controls: tap a task tab to switch scenario
tap a model tier to reprice
drag the profit slider to move the break-even line

dataSource.label: Bai et al., arXiv:2604.22750 (SWE-bench Verified, 8 LLMs, Apr 2026)
